# Beverage Industry

> > Trade publication covering beverage manufacturing, product launches, market trends, and industry innovations across alcoholic and non-alcoholic drink categories.

Beverage Industry provides comprehensive coverage of the beverage manufacturing sector, including emerging trends like the sober-curious movement, low/no-alcohol beverages, and health-wellness innovations. The publication features analysis from industry experts like Caleb Bryant of Mintel, product launches from major brands including PepsiCo, Nestlé, and Bacardi Ltd., and insights into consumer behavior shifts such as Dry January and Sober October.

## Key Topics

- Low-alcohol and no-alcohol beverages
- Sober-curious movement
- Dry January and Sober October
- New product launches
- RTD (ready-to-drink) cocktails
- Flavored malt beverages
- Health and wellness trends
- Mintel beverage research
- Seasonal flavors
- Coffee and instant coffee innovations
- Beverage manufacturing
- Consumer behavior trends
- Non-alcoholic spirits
- Product innovation
- Market analysis

## Industry Trends & Market Analysis

- [Category Focus](https://digitaledition.bevindustry.com/category-focus/): Analysis of low/no alcohol beverage trends and sober-curious movement
